description: This file contains functions and scripts to manage platform-specific upgrade procedures, including image checking, copying configurations, bootloader upgrading, and overall upgrade process for a Linux-based embedded platform.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity of the image, extracts boot sector, and compares partition layouts.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Mounts the relevant partition and copies backup configuration files.

methods.name: platform_do_bootloader_upgrade
methods.description: Upgrades the bootloader by mounting the disk and executing grub-bios-setup.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the main upgrade process, including updating partitions, image writing, UUID updating, and boot configuration.
